roads.name: Highway 533
words: Sweeping and steady: 26 curves in 7.1 miles.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 840 to 996 ft, with 488 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 80 km/h limit its corners still ask for about 0.63 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
